name: dental-clinic-kathmandu
description: BrightSmile Dental Clinic Kathmandu - Premium Dental Care Website in Putalisadak, Kathmandu, Nepal

scripts.build: echo "Build complete - static assets in public_html"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function chk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())chk(p);else if(f.endsWith('.html')){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf-8');if((c.match(/<section/g)||[]).length!==(c.match(/<\/section>/g)||[]).length)throw new Error('Section mismatch in: '+p);}}}chk('public_html');console.log('Verification passed: All HTML files valid.');"
